Lead Technician

What you will do 
As a Lead Technician Utilities, you play a key role in ensuring the reliable operation of the critical utility systems that support our manufacturing, warehousing, and offices. You combine technical expertise with leadership and coaching skills. Working closely with technicians, engineers, contractors, and operations teams, you help ensure maintenance activities are executed safely, efficiently, and compliantly while supporting the development of others. 
You'll work on systems such as HVAC, refrigeration, compressed air, chilled water, boilers, and building automation systems within a modern, highly automated pharmaceutical manufacturing facility. As our site continues to expand, these systems are becoming increasingly important to support future growth. 
In this role, you will: - Coordinate and prioritize maintenance activities across utility systems and facility infrastructure. - Provide technical guidance, coaching, and support to technicians and contractors. - Support troubleshooting of complex utility and facility-related issues. - Work closely with Facilities & Engineering colleagues, contractors, and vendors to resolve technical challenges. - Drive reliability improvements and continuous improvement initiatives. - Participate in the on-call rotation supporting critical utility systems. WIN 
 What we expect from you - MBO+/HBO-level education or equivalent technical experience. - Experience in utilities, facilities, maintenance, or industrial installations. - Strong troubleshooting skills and a hands-on mindset. - Experience coordinating maintenance activities, projects, contractors, or technical teams. - Strong communication skills and the ability to coach and support colleagues. - Good communication skills in English and willingness to participate in an on-call rotation. - Experience in a GMP environment and knowledge of SAP PM or another CMMS platform are a plus. 🕑 14:00 - 22:00
🌙 22:00 - 06:00.

You're guaranteed 3 working days per week, plus 2 reserve shifts. If things get busy, you're called in for extra shifts. Perfect if you like a bit of flexibility!

Where will you work

If you are looking for a job where you can work part-time or full-time, we have the perfect option for you! Join us now as a production employee at Kuehne + Nagel in Zaandam. READY TO TAKE YOUR WAREHOUSE SKILLS TO THE NEXT LEVEL?

- Sorting tasks: Sort boxes and products directly from the sorting machine.

Where will you work

The hours fly by before you know it! It’s a modern company, and you’ll get to know plenty of great colleagues. Plus, as a logistics employee, you can work part-time with a flexible schedule. This allows you to work when it suits you and easily plan around your personal life. You can also earn extra pay by working weekends. On top of that, you’ll be working at bustling Schiphol, making it super easy to reach Aramex by public transport. Yes!

Job application

    - Processing incoming goods and packages
    
- Sorting shipments by postal code
    
- Loading and unloading trucks according to the route (depending on the shift)
    
- Scanning and checking packages and documents

This position involves physically demanding work, such as a lot of walking, carrying, lifting packages, and performing repetitive tasks.

What's in it for you

    - Gross salary of €15.85 per hour, including 1.38% ADV allowance
    
- Long-term position on a temporary employment basis with the possibility of a permanent contract
    
- Part-time job of approximately 20 hours per week

- Working in an international environment

    - Good command of the Dutch or English language, due to safety reasons

Looking for an active job with good pay and attractive shift allowances? Join DHL as a Logistics Employee and work together with your colleagues to ensure parcels reach their destinations on time!

What will you do?

You will help ensure the sorting process runs smoothly. Your tasks include placing parcels on the conveyor belt, handling sorted shipments, and supporting the team with daily operations. Parcels can weigh up to 25 kg. Heavier or difficult-to-lift parcels are always handled together with a colleague. You will work Monday to Friday, 3 to 5 days per week. Shifts generally start around 5:00 PM and end around 2:45 AM. Exact start and finish times may vary.

- You are available at least 3 to 4 days per week.
- You are at least 18 years old.
- You speak Dutch or English.
- You live in or near Zwolle, Meppel, or Kampen.
- You have your own transportation or live within walking distance of the sorting center.

- Welcoming guests and running cash register shifts.
- Delivering an excellent customer experience and keeping tables and the work area clean and tidy.
- Assisting with dishwashing and other cleaning duties.

Where will you work
You'll be working through Tempo-Team. That means you are never just a number; we are your partner in job satisfaction. We believe that when you feel good, your guests notice right away. That’s why flexibility and your preferences always come first with us. As a Catering Assistant at ASML, you can work across multiple locations on site. You'll often work alongside fellow Tempo-Team colleagues. You’ll always be learning something new and will always have a great team around you!

- Set your own schedule and stay in control of your work-life balance.
- Discover variety and growth opportunities across multiple locations in the Eindhov

Job description: Emirates Cabin Crew are responsible for delivering the Fly Better onboard experience to passengers across our global network. As a member of our Cabin Crew team, you will be the onboard representative of our brand, delivering our signature award-winning service while maintaining world-class safety standards. In the role, you will ensure the safety and comfort of our passengers, manage onboard service and maintain cabin cleanliness throughout each flight. You will also uphold the highest of service standards in line with the Emirates Fly Better promise. Candidate profile: To be considered for Emirates Cabin Crew, you’ll need to be: Fluent in written and spoken English (additional languages are an advantage) A natural team player with a personality that shines At least 160cm tall and able to reach 212cm high Able to meet the UAE’s employment visa requirements At least 21 years old And have: At least 1 year of hospitality or customer service experience A minimum of high school (Grade 12) education No visible tattoos while in Emirates Cabin Crew uniform Salary information: Your salary includes a fixed basic pay and variable flying pay, which is calculated using number of hours you fly during the month. As a Freezer reachtruck driver for one of our clients in Maastricht, you are responsible for managing the entire freezer department. You'll be working for a leading wholesaler for the hospitality industry, a family business with locations across the Netherlands and Belgium. The Maastricht branch covers more than 4,000 m² and offers over 100,000 products from around the world, all aimed at hospitality professionals.  Your tasks include inspecting products, preparing them for shipment, and assisting with loading and unloading activities. You will work in a dynamic environment where flexibility and strong physical condition are essential.

Your tasks include: 

- Full responsibility for the freezer department.
- Inspect goods for damages and check expiration dates.
- Prepare products for shipment.
- Assist with loading and unloading of trucks.
- Work in cold conditions down to -25°C.

- A valid reachtuck certificate.
- Comfortable working in cold conditions and working in day shifts. (10:00 - 19:00).
- Able to perform physically demanding tasks.
- Lifting boxes up to 10 kg is no problem for you.
- You have a good command of the Dutch OR English language.
